_comment: AUTHORITATIVE audio limits. Android and the backend both derive from this
file; a parity test on each side fails if they drift apart.
These are ENFORCED limits, not warnings. They replace the old
LONG_AUDIO_WARN_MINUTES=10, which only printed a message and never
rejected anything -- a 30-minute import ran to completion with no ceiling
on time or provider spend.
max_duration_seconds is a PRODUCT requirement (60-minute audio supported,
raised from 30 minutes on 2026-09-14), and also the per-request cost ceiling:
max_duration_seconds 3600 (60 min) ~= Rs 22.7 per request at Deepgram
Nova-3 multilingual rates (Rs 1.51 per 4 min, verified 2026-09-12).
max_upload_bytes 100 MB covers 60 min of 194 kbps AAC (~87 MB) and
60 min of 19 kbps WhatsApp Opus (~8.6 MB). It does NOT cover 60 min of
uncompressed 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV (~115 MB): such a file reaches the
byte cap at about 54.6 minutes.
Lowering max_duration_seconds is the single most effective cost lever.
encoded_duration_tolerance_seconds: container/codec framing the backend
accepts on top of max_duration_seconds. AAC codes whole 1024-sample frames
plus encoder priming, so exactly 3600.000 s of PCM encodes to ~3600.13-3600.16 s
(measured on device). The APP guarantees raw audio <= 3600.000 s (the
recorder stops capture at 3,600,000 ms) and checks the encoded file against
this tolerance before upload; the BACKEND rejects anything longer.
